name: VS Code
description: Open projects and files in VS Code through its official CLI, focus an existing window, and inspect a workspace.

capabilities.name: open_project
capabilities.description: Open a folder in VS Code
capabilities.verification: the VS Code CLI accepted the path and a window exists for it

capabilities.name: open_file
capabilities.description: Open a file in VS Code (optionally at a line)

capabilities.name: focus
capabilities.description: Bring the VS Code window forward

capabilities.name: inspect_workspace
capabilities.description: Report what a project folder contains

capabilities.name: health
capabilities.description: Report whether the VS Code CLI is usable
